subject: Need the complaint summary by Wednesday
text: The calendar entry for our file review appears to have been misread, so I set the session for the wrong afternoon. Since you are already aware, I will keep it practical and avoid another reschedule. Could you send the customer complaint summary by close of business Wednesday? I only need the final version, not the draft notes or meeting agenda. If the document is locked, please share read access instead of exporting it. I also noticed the support ticket list references an older revision; once I receive the correct copy, I will align the response template. If any figures changed from the version shown on the shared drive, flag them in a short note. Otherwise, I will assume the date on the PDF is current and proceed with preparing the customer reply. If you prefer, leave it in the project folder and send me the folder link. I will verify it matches ticket 442 before sending any external response.
